impact: 已有 Session 的交互入口遗漏明确 attach；修复 probe 不会产生缺失的真实方法。不能把 session.get 当 attach 资格。

minimal_changes.change: 进入已有 Session 时先完整 typed read-only attach(request_write_owner=false)，绑定 project/session/cursor；新 create 后按 22 第58行 session.attach(request_write_owner=true)，等待完成并取得合法 snapshot/epoch 再发用户任务。单纯打开不得接管。显式 resume 或经明确写入意图授权的 takeover 必须走完成门；read-only ACK 不生成 send 权限。

minimal_changes.change: 与 P03 同一实现；不得为了增加 method 次数重复发送业务消息。

facts: resume target=session is emitted by both CLI branches. 22 §3.3 requires control target an owned Goal/Run; ControlPayload JSON schema only constrains a nonempty string and cannot enforce domain membership.

ClientService.handleWrite RESUME/session branch only checks pending/fence and terminal predecessor children/queue then returns settled ControlResult/snapshot. It has no ResumeCheckpoint, control producer or native dispatch call. Other non-CANCEL action is rejected NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Service.ResumeCheckpoint is a distinct SCHEDULER-authenticated transaction: original active Run/Task/Goal, revision, checkpoint, trusted stopped-tree/queue observation, effects reconciliation, current input/admission/dependency context, rotated lease and native dispatch. It rejects terminal/CANCEL_REQUESTED Run.
RuntimeCoordinator.RunAdmitted handles a PAUSED bridge journal by sealing observed state then returning; this is not proof that the Session special branch resumes it.
impact: 当前成功只能证明读取并打开可继续的 Session，不能报告恢复暂停执行。活跃/暂停但非 terminal 的 Run 反而被该特殊分支拒绝。

minimum_immediate_bounds.change: 保留合法 positional session-id；从完成且验证的 snapshot 解析所属 Goal/Run target，不能把 Session ID 传作 control target。--writer-epoch 不得成为跳过 attach(true) 的权限来源。
先完成 writer takeover，再派发真实 control；无可恢复 target 时显示明确结果/拒绝，不产生假的 settled RESUME。
移除该分支的真实恢复成功语义，保留 immutable 旧 journal 重放，不修改历史响应。新 RESUME 必须关联当前 Session 的真实 Goal/Run 和 durable 控制事实。

full_runtime_followup_scope_required.boundary: 既有同 Run checkpoint 恢复权威；若抽 caller-Tx helper，必须独立登记。不能从 ClientService 已打开的 Tx 直接调用这个另开 Tx 的公开函数，也不能把用户 credential 当 scheduler token。

full_runtime_followup_scope_required.function: Scan / RunAdmitted / trusted observation and dispatch integration
full_runtime_followup_scope_required.boundary: 消费已提交且授权的恢复意向；不得另造 executor、先发进程再补 journal。需要独立关闭 producer/ownership 设计后方可实施。

unresolved_explicit: PAUSE 的真实安全暂停 producer、Goal resume 到 task/run 的状态转换及 explicit continuation-after-CANCELLED 的新 attempt 分支尚未在本次只读审查中闭合；现有 ResumeCheckpoint 不能替代 cancelled continuation。不能宣称以上5路径足以实现全部恢复，也不得借此提前改 F08/SQL。
preserve: 旧 CANCELLED Run 永不原地复活。
UNKNOWN effect/reservation、不明子进程、恢复 fence、失败次数与预算不清零。
原 Goal/Task/checkpoint、input/runtime historical identity、queue/order/watermark、user explicit flag 和同命令 journal 保留。

facts: v2Call passes strictIdentity=false, used by interactive session.list and cliInit workspace.register/project.bootstrap.

strictIdentity=true checks protocol/command/method and only string session_id mismatch. It still lacks full CommandResponse/result schema, absent/null SID distinction and atomic cross-object adoption.
json.Unmarshal allows duplicate keys; adoptV2Snapshot may update revision before complete snapshot/project/authority checks. IN_PROGRESS is accepted although frozen status enum has only three values.

runCLIVerb passes wait=false for every session.attach; cliFlow.call returns zero on ACK when !wait and continues to get/control. attach(true) zeroes cached epoch, but a later get or manual epoch branch is not equivalent to completed AttachResult.
Host writer guards still apply. These facts prove attempted continuation risk, not an actual successful unauthorized Host mutation.

minimal_changes.change: 所有 /v2 回复先 strict JSON Unicode/duplicate/single-value 校验、UseNumber exact numeric decoding、固定 CommandResponse + method result/PendingResult schema、command/method/session/project/result identity，再一次性采用 context。非法回复保持所有内存/持久 config 字段不变。取消 strict=false 绕行；新 Session creation 是显式唯一 SID 生成例外；host-scope null 合法。

attach(true) 原 command ID、payload、expected revision、null writer_epoch 原封重放直到 COMPLETED，核 write_owner_acquired=true、typed snapshot owner client ID、positive exact epoch、project/session/revision 一致后才能 control/send。ACK 仅 PendingResult，等待超时或冲突保持只读，不改新 revision 盲重试。readonly attach 即使报告 pending也不能颁写权。

existing_validation_reference: cli_contract.go configure transport uses jsontext.Value.IsValid + UseNumber + frozen CommandResponse;可复用已有行为但不得修改它来放宽要求。doctor 当前也有 typed validation；本项不是跨产品重构。
do_not_reuse_uncritically: domain.DecodeResponse 当前允许顶层 NOT_IMPLEMENTED/IN_PROGRESS 且要求非nil revision，会拒绝合法 host-scope null revision；单纯调用它不能作为完整冻结合同验证。无需为 CLI 修复扩大 domain decoder source scope。
preserve: read-only interrupt uses actual cancelled I/O cause; 130 cannot吞真实5xx/JSON错误。
CANCEL ACK 独立追踪/子进程收敛流程不因 attach wait 修改而阻塞。
goal typed adoption、配置 guard、历史稳定 command IDs、单 stdin/network writer 保留。
